description: Angular component for widget settings in Thingsboard UI, managing dynamic forms and embedded settings components.

classes.name: WidgetSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor and Validator for widget settings, supporting dynamic and directive-based configurations.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback for touch events (not implemented).

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles input property changes, updating embedded components accordingly.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions and component references.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form group.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets form data and initializes embedded settings component.

methods.name: useDefinedDirective
methods.description: Checks if a directive-based settings component should be used.

methods.name: useDynamicForm
methods.description: Checks if a dynamic form should be used for settings.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the form data model and propagates changes.

methods.name: validateDefinedDirective
methods.description: Loads and validates the directive-based settings component.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation based on current configuration mode.
